description: Separated the outside noise from the drum, and did not add a figure.
name: Humphrey Larkham

description: Gave two hundred as her figure from the stair, and sent them back to the house.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Heard the shout, looked at Pope, and did not go.
name: Richard Cowley

description: Stayed on his cue, and meant to be louder than the memory of the gate.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Read the plot and played the bill.
name: William Shakespeare
